description: The niches (field, sub-niche, free text, audience; one primary, up to 3) and topics (up to 10) saved for this workspace: its default and each account's own. With account_id, that account only; an account with none of its own shows the workspace default (inherited). Read it before judging what works for an account. taxonomy lists the fields and sub-niches niche_set accepts. Empty niches: call niche_suggest, then niche_set what fits.

account_id.description: One account. Omit for the workspace default and every account

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: niche_get
